content: The DSL shall reset the security level to the value 0x00 (i.e. the security is enabled) under one of the following conditions: - if a transition from any diagnostic session other than the defaultSession to another session other than the de- faultSession (including the currently active diagnostic session) is performed or - if a transition from any diagnostic session other than the defaultSession to the defaultSes- sion (DslInternal_SetSecurityLevel()) (initiated by UDS Service DiagnosticSessionCon- trol (0x10) or S3Server timeout) is performed.
